notes.title: Jump Malcolm Jump Playability update
notes.content:
To make the full set of levels accessible to all skill levels the first level of each world is now unlocked. That means if you get stuck or frustrated on a worlds level you can still proceed further into following worlds.

Additional Checkpoint have been added through levels over all worlds. This will reduce the amount of frustration due to an untimely fail after a complex section

notes.title: Jump Malcolm Jump demo latest update
notes.content:
Better balancing of sound fx vs sound track

There is a now a short animation when Malcolm Falls

Minor changes to the tutorial/class room level

Improved leadboard access - added to main screen & level complete

Leaderboard will now load greater than 10 entries

notes.title: Minor Update to Jump Malcolm Jump Demo
notes.content:
Improvements to controller detection
Various minor bugs fixed

notes.title: Jump Malcolm Jump Demo Update
notes.content:
Running Score is now shown on hud in gameplay
Animations now blend between Walk,Idle,Jump etc
Revamp of Player customisation UI
In Game Escape menu now allows access to Settings
In Game Escape menu now allows to restart level from the beginning with reset of timer
Countdown timer now only starts once player has made first movement
During Level Complete sound the main soundtrack will pause
Auto Pause/Resume on focus away from/back to game
Auto Pause on unplug of controller

notes.title: Untitled
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Subtle improvements to jump mechanism by way of Coyote Time & Jump Buffering
[*] Make it more obvious on player customisations how much is available for spending
[*] Hud now shows total orbs available on the level
[*] Fixed the bounce pad locations on the dungeon level for better transition
[/list]

notes.title: Minor bug fixes
notes.content:
Found some duplicated energy orbs on the warehouse. Cleaned those up, added elsewhere.
Fixed an issue when completing the game on an offchance of > 100% (due to an internal bug) the Complete with 100% achievement would not be achieved. NoW > 100^% will count as 100% complete. Any in progress game > 100% on startup will be detected and the achievement will be awarded
